acceptance_gate_results.principle: Only matching V646 YAML can supply executable tasks.
Both independent authorities must describe the same twelve tasks.
Mutation controls are meaningful only from an exact baseline.
Frozen byte copies must match both source authorities.
Every consumed field must be promised by an earlier producer.
Missing or ineligible producer evidence must fail closed.
Source access can fail while each bounded method decision remains recorded.
The durable study ledger must contain the dated V646 mapping.
This aggregation receipt cannot claim current model inference.
Every selected-roadmap and scoped affected check must pass.

yaml.title: Bind the V646 research delta and twelve-task contract
Separate required validation from scientific acceptance
Diagnose frozen capture accounting and validate a cold reducer
Qualify adapter safety and seal distinct future requests
Capture Qwen3.8 proposals with separate source-fidelity evidence
Measure continuous structural learning on later distinct requests
Independently adjudicate structural-learning evidence and total cost
Adjudicate archived acquisition assumptions and cost without rerunning
Audit cross-game supervisor support and prototype bounded replay
Measure a frozen supervisor ordering on disjoint live games
Preserve authenticated board status and changed-state prerequisites
Reconcile twelve dispositions and decide whether claims advance

yaml.title: Bind the V646 research delta and twelve-task contract
Separate required validation from scientific acceptance
Diagnose frozen capture accounting and validate a cold reducer
Qualify adapter safety and seal distinct future requests
Capture Qwen3.8 proposals with separate source-fidelity evidence
Measure continuous structural learning on later distinct requests
Independently adjudicate structural-learning evidence and total cost
Adjudicate archived acquisition assumptions and cost without rerunning
Audit cross-game supervisor support and prototype bounded replay
Measure a frozen supervisor ordering on disjoint live games
Preserve authenticated board status and changed-state prerequisites
Reconcile twelve dispositions and decide whether claims advance

sample_size_budget.stopping_rule: Stop after twelve comparisons, eight mutations, seven controls per gate, five bounded source requests, and one scoped validation sequence.

source_method_map.adopted_method: Measure support coverage and abstain on branches absent from the ledger.
source_method_map.assumption: Recorded discovery-tree support can rank only replayed supervisor choices.
source_method_map.limitations: A redirect followed by progress is observed support, not the causal outcome of an unobserved alternative.

source_method_map.adopted_method: Freeze one supervisor module and evaluate it on disjoint live games.
source_method_map.assumption: Harness-module contrasts require task-disjoint evaluation and multiple trajectories.
source_method_map.limitations: One failed trajectory cannot identify a general module defect or establish transfer.

source_method_map.adopted_method: Charge every acquisition query and preserve unsupported higher-order counterexamples.
source_method_map.assumption: Pairwise separation and global capacity use Boolean feasibility feedback.
source_method_map.limitations: The restricted acquisition language does not prove arbitrary hidden-rule learning.

source_method_map.adopted_method: Test delayed verified updates on distinct future requests and version changes.
source_method_map.assumption: Prediction reads a frozen memory snapshot and writes only between requests.
source_method_map.limitations: Memory writes and bounded recall results do not establish a Carnot learning benefit.

source_method_map.adopted_method: Keep source-fidelity rows for quantities, entities, and ordering beside executor rows.
source_method_map.assumption: Claim-level evidence links are separate from executable validity.
source_method_map.limitations: Parser success or executable output can still misrepresent the source request.
